name: Obscure Identity
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric 9, sorcerer/wizard 9

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M ( jewel worth 25,000 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target self or one willing creature
Duration see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Obscure identity erases the memory of one willing creature from the minds of all others. Friends, family, and past associates cannot remember her. Any creatures who interact with the subject of this spell after the casting form memories of her as normal, but are not able to speak the creature’s name or verbally discuss her actions, though they may do so in writing.
